title: A Python implementation of some geometric tools on Kendall 3D shape space for practical applications
summary: This work addresses the challenge of analyzing geometric structures using Kendall's 3D Shape Space. While Riemannian geometry provides a robust framework for shape analysis (independent of scale, position, and orientation) the transition from theoretical manifolds to practical computational workflows remains difficult. Although Geomstats is currently the leading Python library for manifold-based statistics, it lacks specific utilities required for advanced 3D shape analysis.
